items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: Sometime he'd have Burybank with him. Play clarinet.

ctx.x: Remember who the clarinet player was?
Yeah, no. The clarinet player, and I... Let's see. Sometime he'd have... This fella, Burybank. Sometime he'd have Burybank with him. Play clarinet.
Punch said he used to play some of the Georgia Boy. Georgia Boy. Did you see in the band?
